question: National Backward Classes Finance & Development Corporation (NBCFDC) is a Government of India undertaking under the aegis of Ministry of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Social Justice and Empowerment**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• T**he National Backward Classes Finance & Development Corporation (NBCFDC) is a Government **of India undertaking under the aegis of the **Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment**
 
• The Ministry is responsible for promoting the welfare and empowerment of socially disadvantaged groups, including backward classes, Scheduled Castes, and Scheduled Tribes.
 
• This Ministry **implements various schemes and programs to address the socio-economic challenges** faced by these communities, such as education, employment, and housing.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
 
 
• The Ministry is responsible for promoting the growth and development of micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) in India.
 
• The Ministry provides financial assistance, technology support, and market access to MSMEs, thereby contributing to job creation and economic growth.
 
 
 
• Ministry of Tribal Affairs
 
 
• The Ministry is responsible for the welfare and development of tribal communities in India.
 
• The Ministry implements various schemes and programs to address the unique challenges faced by tribal communities, such as education, healthcare, and infrastructure development.
 
 
 
• Ministry of Rural Development
 
 
• The Ministry is responsible for promoting the development of rural areas in India.
 
• The Ministry implements various schemes and programs to improve rural infrastructure, agriculture, and livelihoods, thereby reducing poverty and inequality.
